notes: Populate webhook_url, sender_email and sender_domain only after a dedicated Fakturasjekk Brevo transactional setup exists and has been reviewed.

Before any Brevo network verification, manually set transactional email log retention to exactly 1 month, disable stored email previews, and record privacy_settings_verified_at after checking the live Brevo account.
Brevo stores transactional logs without a time limit by default; Fakturasjekk must never rely on that default.
The webhook must point to the Fakturasjekk order-confirmation webhook route and use the configured custom secret header.
Provider acceptance of a synthetic email is not proof of durable-medium delivery; delivered remains a separate live E2E gate.
Never use customer email addresses or customer document data in this verifier.
